title: A running challenge says winners get their free days by themselves, but the owner must now give each one
what: While a challenge runs, the Challenges page tells the owner (in English and Hinglish) that each winner gets the free days added to their plan automatically when it ends. Since the security fix of early November, every winner instead waits for the owner to tap Give or Skip. When all days are in, the page again says they were added by themselves, though the owner gave them.
expected: The running-challenge line says the owner will check and give each winner the days when it ends; the finished line says the days were given.
fix_line: Change the two lines to say the owner gives each winner the days after the challenge ends

title: A gym stopped by MettleUp is called paused on some screens and on hold on others, and neither says why or who to ask
what: The same server refusal (the gym is suspended) reads "Your gym is paused" on Member questions and Busy machines, and "Your gym account is on hold" on workout reports (and on phone-link and plan-request answers). None of the lines says why or how to get it back.
expected: One name for the same state everywhere, with one short line on what to do (for example: message MettleUp).
how_often: only when a gym is suspended
fix_line: Pick one word for it and add who to contact

title: In Hinglish, automatic reminders, the plan-ended banner, Pay MettleUp, workout reports, body measures and member questions stay in English
what: An owner who picks Hinglish sees these screens fully or mostly in English: none of the 39 automatic reminder lines, the plan or trial ended banner, the Pay MettleUp lines, the workout report lines, body measure lines, gym timings or help lines have a Hinglish version, and only 2 of 22 member question lines do. Challenges, Get started, Today tiles and the bell are fully done.
expected: Every line on a screen the owner uses is in the language he picked, or the screen is clearly English-only by choice.
fix_line: Add Hinglish for these screens, starting with the plan-ended banner and reminders

title: Member questions tells the owner members find "Ask about your workout" on the Gym tab, but that row is now "Message your gym"
what: With no questions yet, Member questions says members find "Ask about your workout" on the Gym tab of their app. The Gym tab row is now called "Message your gym"; the old name is left only inside that page and under Settings. An owner telling members where to tap gives them a name they will not find. The same old name is in a What is new note.
expected: The empty line names the row members really see: Message your gym on the Gym tab, then A trainer.
how_often: every gym before its first question
fix_line: Change the line to Message your gym, then A trainer
